name: Zhentarim Ruffian
description: Origin Feat You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Exploit Opening
features.description: When you roll damage for an Opportunity Attack, you can roll the damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.

features.name: Family First
features.description: If you have Heroic Inspiration when you roll Initiative, you can expend it to give yourself and your allies Advantage on that Initiative roll.
